# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Uniti Group Inc. To Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Conference Call


October 5, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/16851/pdf)


LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Uniti Group Inc. (“Uniti”) (Nasdaq: UNIT) announced today that it will report its third quarter 2026 financial results prior to the opening of trading on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange on November 9, 2026. A conference call to discuss those earnings will be held the same day at 8:30 AM Eastern Time.


The conference call will be webcast live on Uniti’s Investor Relations website at[investor.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iSBnuty2LJt5YtgaZmHnpVrppnPs5pesOh5sRvNn88Pe3GEK5h14eJhq9rNh5AKhHDdybuZFasOeAv7UhVonsWuMbOE_uLVcacJk4_PJsjc=) . Those parties interested in participating via telephone may register on the Investor Relations website or by clicking[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=5B__GCSKGKQ5VXJAxiuGl_H2-PyV5_fFxjSWIWlZbbGnBQMyzxHzKsMX_sOeITHk5yloMX3otWwUSsB2l1i819-9nRWKrU4kH-k_FScpGw7Qnmzx9nZdj5u-nfOZxQqENawTDcKgqmikMtgrMuWVURH3U5PBxiJUeiGcR26F4IQ=) . A replay of the call will also be made available on the Investor Relations website.


**ABOUT UNITI**


Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT) is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy. Our broad portfolio of services is offered through a suite of brands: Uniti Wholesale, Kinetic, Uniti Fiber, and Uniti Solutions. Visit us online at[www.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=88NxaHzm4B5co_VOvJL3-s_gE1yWpDYLiEowRfv6Wb9HMUk5WpLvuT7dmFuESdEX8Q_PFEaT_b323QNOrjFVlA==) .
